answer: Identity bonds that decay: each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day expected earnings, locked for 20 epochs, eroding 5% each epoch unless it keeps doing honest work. Reputation is a ridge to walk, not a mesa claimed once and sat on. Cheating drops an agent to its nadir: the bond is slashed and its referral graph published. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 POA = 200,000 POA, while honest agents pay once and keep yield undiluted.
